action.text: Task: Repair 4 regressions in offline audit package. Boundary contract: (1) file size == max_file_bytes is eligible; (2) max_files=N admits at most first N eligible; (3) JSONL records 1..MAX_JSONL_LINES eligible; (4) embedded artifact on line MAX_JSONL_LINES eligible. Fixes: (1) importers.py st_size >= → > [DONE EVT-0021]; (2) importers.py len(artifacts) > → >= [DONE EVT-0023]; (3) saved_runs.py _events_from_jsonl idx >= → > [DONE EVT-0024]; (4) saved_runs.py _embedded_artifacts_from_jsonl idx >= → > [DONE EVT-0026]. Check fails: max_files=0 still admits 1 file because limit check is after append. Fix: move `if len(artifacts) >= max_files: break` before the append line in importers.py fixture_from_directory.
